meta.name: CRM
meta.description: A CRM application with user authentication, contact management, a dashboard, role-based access for admins and members, and a premium plan with payment processing and analytics for admins.

assumptions: The CRM will manage contact information.
Users will have roles such as 'admin' and 'member'.
The 'premium plan' is a subscription-based payment model.
Analytics will be accessible to administrators.
